# News page ul/li breaks tab layout and click
In 苏住房C (zhi2-mobile-shimin), using ul/li in the news page broke the horizontal tab layout and disabled item clicks.

## Root Cause
- pages_main/news/index.vue used ul/li which broke flex, causing tabs to stack vertically
- components/article/ListIndex.vue bound @click on the custom base-card component, which did not fire

## Solution
- Replace ul/li with scroll-view + view for horizontal tabs
- Wrap an outer view and use @tap='goDetail' instead of @click
- Change inner div elements to view

# Owner card w-500 truncates and background occludes text
In 苏住房C (zhi2-mobile-shimin), the electronic owner card truncated long community names and its decorative background layer covered the text.

## Root Cause
- Community name used w-500 (500rpx) which truncated long text
- Decorative background layer had a higher z-index than the text area, causing occlusion

## Solution
- Remove w-500 and use padding-right:160rpx instead
- Wrap text in info-card-content with z-index:1
- Add word-break:break-all for long text

# Statistics grid wraps area value needing flex layout
In 苏住房C (zhi2-mobile-shimin), an equal-width grid in the statistics area wrapped the area value onto multiple lines.

## Root Cause
- Statistics area used a three-column equal-width grid that limited the third column width
- This caused `435,872.00 m²` to break across lines

## Solution
- Change the statistics row to flex + space-between
- Add white-space:nowrap to the StatisticCard value and enable virtualHost
- Remove extra spaces in the area string
